newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Soros stake in El-Rov grows to 14.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Soros stake in El-Rov grows to 14.4 pct.

text.p: Two funds controlled by U.S. investor George Soros have increased their combined holding in El-Rov (Israel) Ltd to 14.4 percent, the company said on Sunday.

El-Rov, a property development and management concern, said the holding was equally divided between Soros' Quantum Emerging Growth Partners CV and his Emerging Dolphin Ltd, a company registered in the British Channel Islands.

Both shareholders became major shareholders under Israeli regulations in the second in mid-December when their individual holdings began to exceed five percent. They have since acquired additional shares.

The 14.2 percent stake makes Soros the second largest shareholder in El-Rov after Alfred Akirov, who has 72 percent of the company. The Soros holdings are worth 36 million shekels at their current market capitalisation, El-Rov said.
